comparator.name: French Language and Culture
comparator.academicYear: Indicative current prospectus: first-year page 2027–2028; second- and third-year pages 2028–2029
comparator.sourceNotes: A complete illustrative 180-EC French-language-and-culture pathway: twelve compulsory 5-EC courses in year one; six compulsory 5-EC courses plus two restricted 15-EC Faculty of Arts minors in year two; required 15-EC study at a francophone university, a 5-EC professional-world course, 30 EC of genuine free choices, and a 10-EC thesis in year three. Zero-credit tutorials and language testing are excluded. The restricted Arts minor space is preserved generically; French-related supplementary minor options are not presented as requirements. The year-specific public listings are explicitly provisional prospective-student information; year two and three currently carry the same illustrative 2028–2029 label, so this reconstruction shows a coherent curricular structure rather than asserting a finalized sequence for a particular entering cohort.

exception.reason: French Language and Culture combines a four-course French proficiency progression through C1 with study of French-language structure, French–Dutch translation and creative writing, francophone literature and culture, a required period studying at a francophone university and a discipline-specific thesis. UCR has a substantial humanities, media, history and communication offer, but no French language course, francophone literary sequence, French linguistics or translation training. A 24-course selection of general culture and communication courses would be a valid different humanities curriculum but not a defensible closest response to this explicitly French-language programme; it would obscure the central language and region-specific requirements.
exception.curriculumContext: The currently published public year pages establish a 180-EC illustrative pathway. The required study abroad is 15 EC of the major and is not added to the separate 30-EC free elective space. Year-two Faculty of Arts minors are restricted choice, not six invented mandatory French modules.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Checked the current GitHub main enriched UCR workbook (151 course rows), including course profiles, prerequisites and planned terms. The literature sequence MCCLITR111/112/211/212/311/312, communication sequence MCCCOMM111/211/213/311/312, media studies MCCMEDI111/112/211/311/312, history and art courses, and HCBCOGN312 Psycholinguistics provide substantial adjacent humanities and general language-analysis material. MCCCOMM112 teaches Dutch, not French. None teaches French proficiency, French linguistics, French–Dutch translation or a focused sequence in francophone literature and culture. The large adjacent cluster cannot supply the missing French-language core of a defensible 24-course closest match.
